string.text: Got any work?
Depends what you can handle. Meat keeps coming in. Good trophies are another matter.
What about those boars down south?
Anything for a night run?
Tell me about that crate in Red Forest.
I am in. Mark the place.
Marked it on your PDA. Terms are there too. Bring it back and we will settle up.
Not this time.
Right. I will come back later.
Nothing suitable right now. I do not send people out on promises.
No regular jobs yet. One day between agreements. Roughly %d hours left.
About our deal.
Well? Brought what you promised?
All here. Take it.
Intact, seals still on. Here is your money.
Cannot handle it. Find someone else.
Fine. I will cancel it and take my equipment and cargo back. Do not expect our people to trust you more for it.
Still on it.
Then keep moving. I need the goods, not stories about the road.
Zhila: bad meat
Zhila: the night tag
Zhila: someone else's haul

A boar pack has settled down south. Something is wrong with their meat. Even the dogs left it alone. Clear the pack and take a sample at their bedding site. I will lend you a sampler: switch it on through your inventory and stay put for thirty-five seconds. Daylight only, six in the morning to eight in the evening. Three days for the job. I will pay %d rubles. Failure or cancellation costs Loner goodwill.

The ecologists lost a tagged chimera. They want their expensive tracker back. Kill the beast at night, ten at night to five in the morning, pick up the dropped tracker and bring it here. It has to be the one from that chimera. Four days for the job. Your cut is %d rubles. Failure or cancellation costs Loner goodwill.

A sealed crate of trophies was left in Red Forest. Five and a half kilos. I will give you the coordinates, but you have twelve hours from this moment for the whole trip, including the return. Bring that exact crate back intact. Do not open it or replace it with your own trophies. Local wildlife might follow. %d rubles. Failure or cancellation costs Loner goodwill.
Deal with the marked boar pack. Zhila needs a sample from their bedding site.
The pack is dead. Take a sample from the bedding site using Zhila's equipment.
Sample collected. Deliver it to Zhila at his workshop.
Kill the marked chimera at night and recover its tracker.
The chimera is dead. Pick up the tracker dropped beside the body.
Tracker recovered. Return it to Zhila at his workshop.
Recover the sealed crate from the marked cache and deliver it to Zhila. Expect trouble.
Crate recovered. Lose the pursuers and return to Zhila.
Deliver the crate to Zhila at his workshop.
Location: %s. Payment: %d RU. Regular jobs: every 24 in-game hours from acceptance. Failure or cancellation lowers Loner goodwill.
Contract record missing. Speak to Zhila.
No active contract for Zhila.
Zhila's field receiver
A battered field receiver with a sampling unit, lent by Zhila for a contract. Activate it through the inventory action menu. Not for sale.
Sealed sample for Zhila
A sample from the boars' bedding site in a sealed container. Zhila is waiting for it in his Rostok workshop.
Hunter's crate
A sealed 5.5 kg shipment for Zhila. This exact crate is required. Delivery deadline: 12 in-game hours from accepting the contract.
Activate Zhila's receiver
Could not issue the contract. Speak to Zhila again.
Zhila marked the location: %s. Payment: %d RU.
Fieldwork complete. Return the cargo or receiver to Zhila.
The receiver is not needed here. Check the PDA marker.
Daylight required for this sample: 06:00–20:00.
This recording must be made at night: 22:00–05:00.
The receiver cannot work now. Wait out the emission in shelter.
Clear the pack first, then approach the marked bedding site.
Sampler on. Remain at the bedding site for 35 seconds.
Receiver on. Stay within 8–30 m of the living chimera.
Signal lost. Recording restarts when conditions are right.
Zhila's receiver: %d%%.
Pack cleared. The bedding site can be sampled.
Crate recovered. Same deadline: 12 in-game hours from receiving the coordinates. Leave the den and return to Zhila.
Something is moving in the trees. It may have picked up the smell.
Zhila's contract failed.
Zhila's deadline has passed. Contract cancelled.
Zhila is dead or missing. The contract cannot be handed in.
Receiver lost. Zhila's contract failed.
Sample container lost. Zhila's contract failed.
The chimera died before recording was complete. Zhila's contract failed.
Hunter's crate lost. Zhila's contract failed.
The haul has spoiled. Zhila will not accept it.
Anything more serious?
One thing. Long road, though. No easy money out there.
What happened to the supplier?
About the missing supplier.
Big jobs do not come in every day. Three days between agreements. Roughly %d hours left.
Location: %s. Payment: %d RU. This job: every 72 in-game hours from acceptance, separately from regular jobs. Failure or cancellation lowers Loner goodwill.
Time remaining: roughly %d hours.
Chimera tracker
A damaged ecologist tracker from the marked chimera. Zhila offered payment for its recovery. Another device will not do.
The chimera was killed outside the required hours. Zhila's night contract failed.
Tracker lost. Zhila's contract failed.
Tracker dropped beside the body. Recover it at the PDA marker.
Zhila: the last run

A supplier went missing in Red Forest. Last call came from an old den. Find out what happened. If he is dead, take his PDA. He kept records of where he hid the goods. Four days to search. Once you read the coordinates, you have twelve hours to recover the shipment and bring it here. Seven and a half kilos. %d rubles for the whole job. Failure or cancellation costs Loner goodwill.
Find the missing supplier in Red Forest. If he is dead, recover his PDA.
Supplier's PDA recovered. Read his notes.
Coordinates received. Recover the sealed shipment of trophies from the marked cache. Expect trouble.
Shipment recovered. Deliver it to Zhila at his workshop.
Missing supplier's PDA
The PDA of a hunter who supplied Zhila. Notes contain the location of a hidden shipment. Read through the inventory action. Receiving the coordinates starts the 12-hour delivery deadline.
Read the hunter's notes
Shipment coordinates recovered and marked on the PDA. You have 12 in-game hours to deliver it to Zhila.
Missing supplier's shipment
A sealed 7.5 kg shipment from the missing supplier's cache. Return to Zhila within 12 in-game hours of reading the hunter's PDA. Ordinary mutant parts cannot replace it.
Shipment recovered. The clock started when you read the PDA. Get moving; the wildlife is close.
Supplier's PDA lost. Zhila's contract failed.
People have occupied the cache site. The original deal cannot be completed. Contract closed.
Zhila is not responding.
Boar jobs: 06:00–20:00. Call during the day.
Chimera jobs: 22:00–05:00. Call at night.
The sampler comes with the contract. The deadline starts when you accept.
